newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 reclaims 4,900, buoyed by Dow rebound.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 reclaims 4,900, buoyed by Dow rebound.

text.p: Britain's leading share index snapped a four-day losing streak on Tuesday, rebounding 1.6 percent following a solid recovery on Wall Street, dealers and strategists said.
Relief the German central bank didn't raise interest rates added fuel to the Wall Street-inspired advance early on, they said.
The FTSE 100 index climbed 79.2 points to 4,914.2, near the day's best level, as advancers outpaced decliners 74 to 22.
Second-liners did not fare quite as well, with the FTSE 250 rising 17.2 points, or 0.4 percent, to 4,680.8.
